text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho begins! One of
the
so-called "average" runners,
Матиканэтангейзер,
is a little
simpleminded, but easy to get along

with.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But Нарита Брайан sees the strength that
lies within
her when Матиканэтангейзер
declares that she
won't lose. Brian
responds by resolving to give it
her all as
well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
